stories.text: 🪦 FRESH OBITUARY: Stacey's Smart Team has been laid to rest (5.76 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🏟️ Game to watch: TB @ DAL (Thursday 8:15 PM), 10 league starters in action with 127.58 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Thursday 8:15 PM (TB @ DAL): 10 league starters, led by Kirbo Crushers vs Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
🔁 Trade that should have happened: LaPorta and Strange ↔ Tate and Herbert back in Week 1 would have helped both sides.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Moose Knucklers leads the chopping-block odds at 29%, with Team Name next at 25%.
🔭 Player to watch: Dak Prescott (TB @ DAL). ESPN projects 18.02 pts, and 49er Faith-Fool is 48% against Mr. Action Jackson.
🎯 10 teams are in the thick of the median race, with Kirbo Crushers right on the line (48%).
🤝 Rivalry week: The Mahomies leads TDsMaGee 5–3 all-time, and The Mahomies has won the last 2.
🎲 Ramosverse is rolling with 3 TEs (McBride, Ferguson and Hockenson) and just 2 healthy RBs. It's a bold strategy, Cotton. Let's see if it pays off for 'em.
🧊 THIN ICE: The Mahomies has no healthy backup RB behind Love and Williams. One more injury and there's a hole in the lineup.
🥊 Waiver tug-of-war: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy beat Ruffing the Passer and The Mahomies to Will Shipley. Condolences to the rest.
⚔️ Mr. Action Jackson vs 49er Faith-Fool is projected to finish just 2.59 pts apart.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
